summary: EU-West: streaming disconnects / truncated output during peak (CloudCart)
description:
Issue summary:
CloudCart reports intermittent streaming disconnects on Hosted API in eu-west. They describe "truncated output" and occasional "socket hang up" in their Node client.

Impact:
Customer production workflow intermittently returns partial responses.

Notes:
Raised during the eu-west streaming disconnect ratio alert in #incidents (thread_ts=1773815400).
comments: Naomi Feldman (Support) 2026-03-18: Creating case per #incidents. Customer report matches known issue pattern. Linking Confluence known issue page.
Aisha Rahman (SRE) 2026-03-18: During incident we rolled back rwd-edge-1.42.0 -> 1.41.3 in eu-west. Streaming disconnect ratio returned to baseline.
Naomi Feldman 2026-03-19: Customer confirms behavior improved after rollback window. Asking them to provide any remaining request ids.
Aisha Rahman 2026-03-22: No further spikes observed. Marking resolved; will re-open if recurrence after next edge rollout.
resolution: Resolved after eu-west edge rollback during 2026-03-18 streaming disconnect incident. Customer advised to implement retry on unexpected end-of-stream.
